'''Guilea''' was a drug with "euphoric qualities," and a form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="Fact File 128">{{FactFile|128|MON 1-4|Ephant Mon}}</ref> It came from the [[tecave]] grass, found only on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]]. Because the grass needed a molecular trace of the rare mineral [[malium]] to grow, [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] had a virtual monopoly on its production and export was strictly prohibited.
